blocks.text: The ZIA Users page show the user data synced from your Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) tenant. Any user configuration or changes that you make on the User Management pages in the ZIA Admin Portal are synced to this page.
The ZIA Users page provides the following benefits and allows you to:

blocks.item: View the users added to your ZIA tenant.
View the list of users that are computed for Business Insights.

blocks.text: On the ZIA Users page (Administration > ZIA Users > ZIA Users), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Search for a user by User ID or Name, Group, or Department.
View a list of configured users. For each user, you can view:
User ID or Name: The user's username or domain name.
User Name: The user's display name.
Groups: The groups the user belongs to.
Department: The department the user belongs to.
Status: The status of the user (Enabled or Disabled).
Comments: The comments regarding the user, if available.
Modify the table and its columns.
